바이어가 1만 개 이상 주문에 대해 단가를 낮춰 달라고 했어요.

read.title: Re: Price Request for Ceramide Cream
read.text:
Dear Ms. Tan,

Thank you for your order plan for the ceramide cream. We understand that your target unit price is 2.20 dollars. Unfortunately, this price would leave us with almost no margin because of rising packaging costs.

As a counteroffer, we can offer 2.35 dollars per unit if you increase the first order to 15,000 pieces. We believe this meets you halfway and still allows you a healthy retail margin.

This price is valid until the end of this month.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

write.task: 바이어가 단가를 10% 내려 달라고 했어요. 그대로는 어렵다고 정중히 말하고, 주문 수량을 늘리면 4% 할인해 주겠다고 역제안하는 메일을 써 보세요.
write.en: Write an email declining a 10% price cut and offering a 4% discount for a larger order.
write.model:
Dear Mr. Kim,

Thank you for your proposal. Unfortunately, a 10% discount is difficult for us because of our current margin. However, we can offer a 4% discount if you increase the order to 12,000 units. We hope this meets you halfway. Please let me know your thoughts.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
